title: Coins
statementMd:
One day Vasya came across three Berland coins. They didn't have any numbers that's why Vasya didn't understand how their denominations differ. He supposed that if one coin is heavier than the other one, then it should be worth more. Vasya weighed all the three pairs of coins on pan balance scales and told you the results. Find out how the deminations of the coins differ or if Vasya has a mistake in the weighting results. No two coins are equal.

## Input

The input data contains the results of all the weighting, one result on each line. It is guaranteed that every coin pair was weighted exactly once. Vasya labelled the coins with letters «`A`», «`B`» and «`C`». Each result is a line that appears as (letter)(> or < sign)(letter). For example, if coin "`A`" proved lighter than coin "`B`", the result of the weighting is `A<B`.

## Output

It the results are contradictory, print `Impossible`. Otherwise, print without spaces the rearrangement of letters «`A`», «`B`» and «`C`» which represent the coins in the increasing order of their weights.
statementZhMd:
一天，Vasya 遇到了三枚 Berland 硬币。它们上面没有任何数字，因此 Vasya 无法了解它们面值之间的差异。他猜想，如果一枚硬币比另一枚更重，那么它的价值就应该更高。Vasya 用天平称量了三对硬币，并告诉了你称量结果。请判断这些硬币的重量关系，或者判断 Vasya 的称量结果是否有误。任意两枚硬币的重量都不相同。

## 输入格式

输入数据包含所有称量结果，每行一个。保证每对硬币都恰好称量了一次。Vasya 用字母 «`A`»、«`B`» 和 «`C`» 标记三枚硬币。每个称量结果占一行，格式为（字母）（> 或 < 符号）（字母）。例如，如果硬币 "`A`" 比硬币 "`B`" 轻，则称量结果为 `A<B`。

## 输出格式

如果称量结果相互矛盾，输出 `Impossible`。否则，不要输出空格，输出由字母 «`A`»、«`B`» 和 «`C`» 组成的排列，表示硬币按照重量递增的顺序。
